Let \(z=x+iy\). The second equation becomes the perpendicular bisector of the points \(4+k\) and \(k+3i\):

\[
|z-(4+k)|=|z-(k+3i)|
\]

which simplifies to

\[
8x-6y-8k-7=0.
\]

The first equation is the circle centered at \(25+20i\) with radius \(5\):

\[
|z-(25+20i)|=5.
\]

For the system to have exactly one solution, this line must be tangent to the circle. The distance from \((25,20)\) to the line is

\[
\frac{|8(25)-6(20)-8k-7|}{\sqrt{8^2+(-6)^2}}
=
\frac{|73-8k|}{10}.
\]

Setting this equal to the radius \(5\):

\[
|73-8k|=50.
\]

So

\[
73-8k=50 \quad \Rightarrow \quad k=\frac{23}{8},
\]
or
\[
73-8k=-50 \quad \Rightarrow \quad k=\frac{123}{8}.
\]

The sum of all possible values of \(k\) is

\[
\frac{23}{8}+\frac{123}{8}=\frac{146}{8}=\frac{73}{4}.
\]

Thus \(m=73,\ n=4\), and

\[
m+n=77.
\]

ANSWER: 77
